name: unzip

flags.description: Extract all files into the current directory.
Password (insecure on the command line — visible in history).

examples.explanation: Extracts into the (existing or created) project directory, keeping the tree tidy.
Previews contents first — the safe habit with unknown archives.
Overwrites existing files without prompting — useful for re-deploys, dangerous on shared data.

about: unzip restores the zip's internal paths. Zips created on Windows may contain non-UTF-8 filenames, which show as mojibake; unzip -O cp437 (or -O cp850) can fix encoding on GNU builds.
mistakes: Extracting into the current directory and mixing files with existing ones — use -d.
Passing passwords with -P: they land in shell history.
